INSERT INTO "ASiruk".external_interviews
    (employee_id, company, held_at, scores, comment, imported_by)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.employee_id }},
  '{{ $json.company }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.held_at }}', '')::date,
  '{{ $json.scores_json }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.comment }}',
  {{ $json.imported_by === null ? 'NULL' : $json.imported_by }}
)
RETURNING id, employee_id, company, held_at;

UPDATE "ASiruk".employee_competencies ec
SET status = 'in_progress', updated_at = now()
FROM jsonb_array_elements('{{ $('1. Разобрать').first().json.scores_json }}'::jsonb) AS s
JOIN "ASiruk".competencies c ON c.name = s->>'competency_name'
WHERE ec.employee_id = {{ $json.employee_id }}
  AND ec.competency_id = c.id
  AND ec.status = 'not_started'
RETURNING ec.competency_id, ec.status;
